content_sections.heading: JAU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available - 6 for Project Assistant, 1 for Senior Project Assistant, and 1 for Junior Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by JAU?
faq.answer: Junagadh Agricultural University (JAU) has announced a total of 8 vacancies for the Project Assistant posts. These positions are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JAU Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 22 September 2026. There is no separate last date for application submission.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the JAU Project Assistant roles?
faq.answer: The required qualifications vary by post. They include Agri. Diploma / Polytechnic in Agriculture with experience, M.Sc. in Agricultural Entomology or Plant Pathology, and B.Sc. in Agriculture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JAU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules for reserved categories and women.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant positions at JAU?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 16,000/- to Rs. 25,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and qualification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the JAU Project Assistant jobs?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with all necessary original documents and photocopies at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the JAU Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Junagadh Agricultural University (JAU), Junagadh, Gujarat. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the JAU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with passport-size photographs.
